verdict.rationale: Beamer is documented as a 'changelog as a service' app for announcing product changes. Its widget can be tailored to fit the app's design and is installed in-product with a simple embed code, which directly delivers an embeddable changelog widget for showcasing updates. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the widget, and detailed first-party embed/installation documentation beyond marketing-level claims.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget

citations.quote: Announce your latest product changes, new features, bug fixes, news and more with Beamer’s changelog as a service app
Tailor our widget to perfectly fit your app’s design.
Install in five minutes](/install) with a simple embed code or Wordpress plugin.
